a.speaker: narrator
a.text: Skye was sitting on the rooftop couch, her head tipped toward the music. She looked up at me.

b.speaker: skye
b.text: Hey. Come sit with me. This is my favorite part.

choices.text: I saw your Petpet Park cue sheet at the studio.

ketchup.speaker: skye
ketchup.text: Yeah. Those packets fight back. Did I leave a mess?

c.speaker: skye
c.text: I’ve only been gone a few hours! I wanted to hear the new music up here.

end.speaker: detective
end.text: Case closed. Missing for: a few hours.

cues.speaker: skye
cues.text: Pukapuka Island and Mystimar Glenn! You went looking for my music, too.

radio.speaker: detective
radio.text: Dispatch, I found Skye. She’s up on the roof listening to music. She’s safe.

check.speaker: detective
check.text: Just a stain. The agents sent me to find you. Are you okay?

checkin.speaker: detective
checkin.text: I’ll tell them you’re up here listening. They’ve been worried.

check_unseen.speaker: detective
check_unseen.text: I came looking for you. Are you okay?

idea.speaker: detective
idea.text: Your last message said you had the best idea for a new game. Then nothing.

idea2.speaker: skye
idea2.text: Oh! I never finished the thought, did I. Okay: a detective shows up in the city looking for me. And by the time they find me, they know me.

idea3.speaker: detective
idea3.text: I looked at my coat. Then at her.

know.speaker: skye
know.text: And you really looked. That’s most of my life down there.

know_some.speaker: skye
know_some.text: You saw some of me on the way up. The rest is still down there whenever you want it.

bag.speaker: detective
bag.text: There’s a bag at the Port with your arrival time on it.

bag2.speaker: skye
bag2.text: My bag! I knew I forgot something.

stay.speaker: skye
stay.text: Stay for the next song. Then come meet everybody. There’s a place we all hang out.
